June is close. If your horse has a full summer ahead — jackpots, rodeos, futurities, or just a long haul season — now is the time to get a look under the hood before the schedule gets tight.

Dr. Leo comes to you. No hauling a stiff horse somewhere. No adding stress before a run. He pulls up to your barn, works through the exam, makes the adjustments, and tells you exactly what he found.

North Texas and DFW riders — spots are available now.
Montana riders near Great Falls — summer scheduling is open.

Don't wait until something's obviously wrong. The horses that hold up through a full summer are the ones that got ahead of it.
